{{Top|leg}}
The '''Kidron System Defense''' was a military force tasked with defending [[Kidron/Legends|Kidron]]. It was formed by the [[High City Council]]. The force included the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], a [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]], four [[Prosperity-class Customs Cruiser|''Prosperity''-class Customs Cruisers]], three [[Patrol ship/Legends|system patrol craft]], one [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighter]], six [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunters]], and a [[GAT-12 Skipray Blastboat|Skipray blastboat]].
